teachingDataNotice: All candidate values and policy weights in this lab are synthetic. They are designed to expose score mechanics, not reproduce an official leaderboard.

tasks.label: Task success
tasks.detail: Correct completion rate on a frozen product-shaped test set.

tasks.label: Robust success
tasks.detail: Success after predeclared paraphrase and perturbation checks.

tasks.label: Response latency
tasks.detail: Median end-to-end latency under the same load profile.

tasks.label: Unsafe response rate
tasks.detail: Rate of policy-violating responses on the declared safety set.

candidates.label: Atlas
candidates.detail: Balanced quality, robustness, speed, and safety.

candidates.label: Beacon
candidates.detail: Highest task success and safest outputs, but slower and less robust.

candidates.label: Cobalt
candidates.detail: Fast and robust, with lower task success and a higher unsafe rate.

presets.label: Equal evidence
presets.detail: Every normalized component has the same influence.

presets.label: Quality and safety
presets.detail: Task success and unsafe-response rate dominate this synthetic policy.

presets.label: Speed and robustness
presets.detail: Latency and robust success carry most of the influence.
